ns2:course.label: Writing with Video
ns2:course.description: Students will engage in a comprehensive exploration of creative inquiry, self-reflection, social engagement, and media production. They will adapt the basic, traditional principles of critical writing and analysis, to communicate effectively using image production and post-production. Directed writings in concert with video production projects will allow students to experience an integrated process of thinking, creating, and problem-solving. Prerequisite: Any Composition I course.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Advanced Composition, Literature and the Arts, and Western Compartv Cult course.
